能说出函数的定义域、对应关系和值域
set.description: 用集合与对应理解函数：定义域中每个 x 都对应唯一的 y。
set.name: The concept of a function

set.reason: Contrasting disjoint alternatives with sequential choices helps choose an operation. An array of shirts and trousers establishes the product principle independently of the addition rule.
The theorem identifies the coefficient of each term as a combination number. The coefficient interpretation uses C(n,k), not necessarily its factorial algorithm.
set.scope: identifying binomial coefficients in the expansion

set.reason: Single-valued correspondence helps formalize the encoding and its inverse. However, elementary bijective counting can work through informal one-to-one pairing without set-theoretic function language.

criteria: Specify an encoding and its inverse.
Check that eligible objects are neither omitted nor repeated.
set.description: Count a finite family by constructing a one-to-one and onto correspondence with another family whose size is known.
set.name: Counting through a bijection

criteria: Justify a power cycle or repeated-square reduction.
When using an exponent theorem, check its prime-modulus and coprimality hypotheses.
set.description: Reduce large integer powers modulo a positive integer using repeated squaring, residue cycles, or applicable exponent theorems with their conditions.
set.name: Powers modulo an integer

criteria: 能用定义判断 A 是否为 B 的子集
知道 A=B 就是互相包含
set.description: 能判断子集和集合相等，知道空集是任何集合的子集。
set.name: Subsets and set equality

criteria: 能判断情形是否要分步相乘
能计算各步办法数的乘积
set.description: 完成一件事要依次做若干步，每步的办法数相乘就是总办法数。
set.name: Multiplication Principle of Counting

criteria: 能判断情形是否要分类相加
能计算互斥类别的办法总数
set.description: 完成一件事有若干类办法，类与类互斥，总办法数等于各类办法数相加。
set.name: Addition Principle of Counting

criteria: Justify what history the state must retain and the relevant initial or absorbing conditions.
Combine transitions correctly for the chosen count, probability, or expectation target, including per-step cost for waiting times.
For an infinite-horizon expected waiting time, justify finiteness or the intended minimal nonnegative solution; do not infer it from formal recurrence algebra alone.
set.description: Choose states retaining the information needed for the next step. Construct count or probability recurrences, or first-step equations for expected remaining cost/waiting time with transition probabilities and per-step cost. Apply initial or absorbing conditions. For an infinite-horizon expectation, justify finiteness or establish the intended minimal nonnegative solution before treating a solved linear system as the expectation.
set.name: Counts, probabilities, and expected waiting times by state recursion
set.nameZh: 状态递推计数、概率与期望等待时间

criteria: 能计算组合数
知道 C(n,0)=1
set.description: 组合数 C(n,k)=n!/(k!(n−k)!)，也等于排列数除以 k 的阶乘。
set.name: Formula for the number of combinations

criteria: 能说出展开式的项数
能求出指定项的二项式系数
set.description: (a+b)^n 的展开式是 C(n,k) a^(n−k) b^k 各项的和，k 从 0 取到 n。
